title: Richard M. Jones, Dave Perkins, his father's friends and cousin Peter Raphael
summary: Asked about Donaldsonville-area musicians, he names Jones, Porter, Dave Perkins as a teacher of white and colored pupils, and his father's friends, then explains that Aunt Bella is the mother of drummer Peter Raphael, his first cousin.
